items.title: Has American Water Works Company (AWK) Fallen Far Enough To Look Fairly Valued?
items.summary: American Water Works Company stock has delivered a decline of about 16.5% over the past 5 years, even as the latest Dividend Discount Model (DDM) intrinsic value estimate points to the shares trading at a premium to that model while earnings based multiples look closer to fair. Over the past 5 years, the share price is down around 16.5%, which may make the current level look more interesting to investors who focus on longer holding periods.
